question.problem:
Consider the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{1}+6{x}_{2}+2{x}_{3}=-8 \\ {x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=2 \\ -3{x}_{1}+9{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3}=-12.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
question.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for the system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 6 & 2 & -8 \\ 1 & -2 & 1 & 2 \\ -3 & 9 & 3 & -12\end{aligned}].
$$

Reducing $M$ to echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}-2 & 6 & 2 & -8 \\ 1 & -2 & 1 & 2 \\ -3 & 9 & 3 & -12\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=-\frac{1}{2}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & -1 & 4 \\ 1 & -2 & 1 & 2 \\ -3 & 9 & 3 & -12\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-1){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & -1 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -2 \\ -3 & 9 & 3 & -12\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & -1 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
